entries.wording: 运件抵达我司操作中心
entries.note: The shipment reached the line's operation centre in Shenzhen: the first row in its hands.

entries.wording: 提单配载已完成，运件离开我司操作中心
entries.note: Loaded under its bill of lading and left the operation centre for the port.

entries.wording: 申报信息&计费数据已确认
entries.note: The declaration and the billing data confirmed, after the shipment left the operation centre: paperwork on the way to the port.
Export clearance under way in Shenzhen, a routine step before the sailing.
The ship left the port of loading in China.
The voyage is late and its arrival moved to the date after the ellipsis, as 27.JAN: the shipment is still at sea.
Import customs in the United States released the shipment, three days before the ship arrived.
The ship reached the port of discharge.
Booking the container's pickup at the terminal.
The container was picked up from the terminal.
The container was unloaded at the destination warehouse.
The shipment was sorted for its delivery.

entries.wording: 卡车派送已出仓，预计1工作日送达
entries.note: The delivery truck left the warehouse, due within a working day; it delivered the same morning.

entries.wording: 卡车派件已送达，POD签收单待回传
entries.note: The truck delivered the shipment; the signed proof of delivery is still to come back.
The signed proof of delivery came back, after the delivery: the platform's status is then signed.
